summary: Treasure's isometric Genesis action-adventure, later preserved through Virtual Console, Sega Classics, mini-console, and Nintendo Classics releases.

entries.title: Light Crusader

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for a legal current path; Genesis Plus GX is suitable for an owned-dump archival setup.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with emulator save-state and rewind conveniences.

primary.why: The Switch Online Genesis release is the current official access path with save-state and rewind convenience, while the original Genesis cart and older digital/mini-console routes do not add exclusive game content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the SEGA Genesis app through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack. For owned PC capture, a retained Sega Classics copy remains a fallback after Sega's delisting notice.

entries.remaster_caveats: All modern paths are emulated Genesis releases rather than remasters.
